message.content: Based on the discussions provided, LiHua has expressed positive sentiments towards Black Myth: Wukong, particularly regarding its graphics and gameplay. Initially, LiHua commented that the graphics looked "insane" and described the gameplay as "so immersive." Later, in another conversation, LiHua elaborated further, stating that she enjoyed the combat style and how it blended with the storyline. She also highlighted her appreciation for the exploration aspect, noting the enjoyment of discovering new areas and secrets within the game. This aligns with the information shared by ThaneChambers, who commended the game's stunning visuals and top-notch storytelling. Overall, LiHua seems quite satisfied with the visual aesthetics and gameplay mechanics of Black Myth: Wukong.
